rules.statement: Verification must cover reset values of every register and the access type (rw, ro, wo, rw0c) of every register field.
Verification must cover the tick generator (prescaler) and the step, and counting of the 64-bit timer value including writes to it and carry from lower to upper half.
Verification must cover the compare and the interrupt: state, enable, test, and clearing by writing the compare registers.
Verification must cover ALERT_TEST with its regwen field, bus error responses (unmapped addresses, sub-word writes, instruction fetches, integrity errors) and the fatal_fault alert.

rules.condition: Because the 64-bit timer value cannot be run through its whole range in simulation
rules.statement: Behaviour close to 2^64 must be reached by writing the timer value registers rather than counting up to it.
